DECLARE

 IF lifetrack_timezone_convert.is_timezone_enabled 
 THEN
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:GLOBAL.chapter_id, SYSDATE, v_local_date);
 END IF;
 IF :ctrl_blk_1.testing_facility IS NOT NULL 
 THEN 
 BEGIN 
 SELECT testing_lab_id
 ,testing_lab_name 
 INTO :GLOBAL.testing_facility

 FROM valid_testing_labs 
 WHERE testing_lab_id = :ctrl_blk_1.testing_facility AND 
 --sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1) and -------------SCR 18938

 ROWNUM = 1
 ;
 EXCEPTION

 THEN 
 show_error('5903');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END;
 ELSE
 NULL;
 END IF;
END;

 , 'OPS$', SUBSTR(:banner.user_id, 5)
 , :banner.user_id
 ) 
 INTO curr_user
 FROM DUAL;

 :GLOBAL.testing_facility= ' ' 
 THEN
 GO_ITEM('ctrl_blk_1.testing_facility');

 END IF;

 THEN

 END IF;

 INTO ncount

 ,REPORT_NAME

 --AND report_name = 'RSMREPRT' -- Commented by Kishore on 06/27/2014. SCR 20196
